parties: Refex Holding Private Limited; Refex Industries Limited
headline: Refex Holding Private Limited submits SEBI Takeover Disclosure
sum: Refex Holding Private Limited filed a mandatory Regulation 31(1) disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE, signalling a material change in shareholding or acquisition intent in Refex Industries Limited.
implication: The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure obligations; partners should confirm whether a full takeover bid or creeping acquisition is contemplated and review conditions precedent and open offer requirements under Regulations 3–4 of SAST 2011.
detail: Refex Holding Private Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE on 18 August 2026 in compliance with Regulation 31(1) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The nature and quantum of the acquisition, the consideration, and the timeline remain undisclosed in the available filing summary. This is a gated disclosure event requiring verification of full form details and follow-on announcements for open offer triggers.
